items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I can remember one time going with Mildred when he and Harry Barris were living together

ctx.x: Yeah, cause I can remember one time going with Mildred when he and Harry Barris were living together and the gin bottles were all over the joint, but he like -- oh man he got up, offered Mildred the chair, Oh, Mildred, happy to -- you know, but polite to the end.
